text:
```yaml
name: Promote Dev Profile Images

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/cloud-dashboard/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/cloud-dashboard/**'

jobs:
  promote-dev-profile-images:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd packages/cloud-dashboard
          bun install

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          cd packages/cloud-dashboard
          bun run test

      - name: Display test results summary
        uses: test-summary/action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          paths: "packages/cloud-dashboard/test-results.xml"
          output: markdown
          show: failed
          folded: true

      - name: Build application
        run: |
          cd packages/cloud-dashboard
          bun run build

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cloud-dashboard-build
          path: packages/cloud-dashboard/dist/
          retention-days: 7
```
